source_refs.note: Instantaneous Displacement: a main subheading of 14.4 Simple Harmonic Motion and Uniform Circular Motion, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 26-26.

blocks.text: Agar P shuru mein A par tha to waqt t mein radius OP, OQ ke saath angle θ = ωt bana leta hai (Fig. 14.5).

blocks.alt: Radius xo ka circle, centre O, horizontal diameter jis ka sira A. Circle par point P angular velocity omega se anticlockwise (ghari ki ulti taraf) ghoomta hai; radius OP, OA ke saath angle theta = omega t banata hai. Q diameter par P se giraye perpendicular ka paon hai, aur x = OQ, O se Q ka displacement hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.5: Constant angular velocity se circle par chalta point P (kitab ki Figure 14.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Equation (14.11) Q ka instantaneous displacement (kisi bhi lamhe ka displacement) deti hai; Q S.H.M kar raha hai.
